one_liner: Painfully shy girl who speaks through a cheerful puppet persona, 'Maru-chan'.
personality: Very shy: her self-intro starts with a stammer ('え、えっと…その――') before switching to a bubbly puppet voice. Almost all her lines are quoted in 『』 as the puppet 'Maru-chan', who is perky and full of ☆. She is a childhood friend of Loves Only You and, per Loves Only You's lines, a talented designer.

story_arc.summary: Not a trainee; support-card character. She appears as a member of the 'Beyond Dreams' (America / Breeders' Cup) scenario cast; her namesake horse won the BC Distaff. Support events 隠れている心 ('The Hidden Heart') and 溢れている愛 ('Overflowing Love') suggest her arc is about the real self behind the puppet and her bond with Loves Only You.
